Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.65 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Dalmau, District Raebareli.
3. In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that the daughter of the informant was married to the applicant on 04.02.2024 and sufficient dowry was given.
On 15.02.2024, the entire matrimonial family had killed her.
The postmortem report on record does not ascertain the cause of death and the viscera was sent for chemical analysis.

sentences.text: The treatment report on record indicates that the blood pressure level found to be very low.
4. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

5. Considering the fact that the cause of death could not be ascertained and there is nothing specific to link the applicant with the offence in question; the applicant is a lady; she is aged about 58 years coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal antecedents and is languishing in jail since 29.02.2024, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Nirmala Devi be released on bail in the aforesaid first information report on her furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which she is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
